subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently replace the iPhone tab bar and Control hub with this shared sidebar shell once the bounded completeness defects are repaired?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the primary iPhone navigation model, and the protected maintainer label plus prior review establish that implementation correctness alone cannot decide the long-term product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the sidebar redesign
options.body: Confirm the sidebar shell as the permanent iPhone navigation direction and require the bounded roster/attention completeness fixes before merge.

options.title: Narrow the redesign
options.body: Keep only the supported navigation improvements while preserving a tab-based primary navigation model for iPhone.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Defer the redesign until an owner decision or broader iOS navigation plan is recorded.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the sidebar redesign
recommendation.body: Confirm the sidebar shell as the permanent iPhone navigation direction and require the bounded roster/attention completeness fixes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history places steipete closest to the proposed iOS navigation direction and its implementation.
